# Metric service collaboration

Rotate data engineering, API and analysis roles. Reconcile a payment fan-out defect across the model, service totals and consumer report.

## Input and contract
input/fixture.json; input/dictionary.md; project version 1

## Finding and reproducible output
```json
{
  "model": [
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "channel": "web",
      "ordered": 12000,
      "paid": 12000
    },
    {
      "id": "A2",
      "channel": "community",
      "ordered": 8000,
      "paid": 8000
    },
    {
      "id": "A3",
      "channel": "web",
      "ordered": 6000,
      "paid": 0
    }
  ],
  "api": {
    "version": 2,
    "cents": 26000
  },
  "feedback": {
    "to": "engineering",
    "issue": "payment_fanout",
    "order": "A1"
  },
  "revision": 2
}
```

## Failure prevented
An inflated order amount must be traced to the one-to-many join.

## Decision and limits
Accept only the specified result set. Escalate a missing identity, permission, business probe or required not-run item. This is an original synthetic teaching reference, not evidence of learner execution or real employment.

files.query.sql: SELECT o.id,o.channel,o.cents AS ordered,COALESCE(p.paid,0) AS paid FROM orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT "order" AS id,SUM(cents) AS paid FROM payments GROUP BY "order") p ON p.id=o.id ORDER BY o.id;
